senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Todah (an adaptation of תַּדַּאי, Thaddæus, for the sake of paronomasia), one of the disciples of Jesus.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 43a:26">Snh. 43ᵃ</cite> (missing in later editions) <he>חמשה … ות׳</he> Jesus had five disciples; Matthew, … and T.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 43a:24">Ib.</cite> <he>אתיוה לת׳ אמר ת׳ יהרג וכ׳</he> they brought up T., and he said, shall T. be put to death? is it not written (<cite ref="Psalms 100:1">Ps. C, 1</cite>), a song of T.? Said they to him <he>אין ת׳ יהרג וכ׳</he> yes, T. shall be slain, for it is written (<cite ref="Psalms 50:23">Ps. L, 23</cite>), he who sacrifices T. honoreth me.
